race.comment: MACAROON (2) gave a good sight in front before weakening late to finish third on debut at Bathurst just over 3 weeks ago. She had won a trial before that, and this looks like an ideal target for her. She should go close to giving former top NZ apprentice Amber Riddell her first win in NSW for the Baker stable. THREE WISHES (4) did not help herself last time out when making a sluggish start, and ended up finishing sixth, but still only a length and a half from the winner. Stick with her on an each-way basis in a modest contest. BOUND FOR PATTAYA (7) will find this easier than any of his 3 starts at provincial level, and from a good gate with Jean Van Overmeire taking the ride, he can figure in the top 3 this time. INVASION (9) cops a wide gate, and has yet to feature in a couple of starts to date. He is worth another chance at odds. AXHRO (6) battled away fairly well in tougher company last start, and he will be fully fit now, fourth up from a spell. Include in all top 4 combos.
